8411.t: From συλλέγω (sullégō, “to gather, collect”) + -η (-ē, abstract noun suffix).

8441.t: From συν- (sun-, “with, together”) + πίνω (pínō, “to drink”). Compare Ancient Greek ἀναπίνω (anapínō).

8447.t: From συν- (sŭn-, “with, together”) + φύω (phŭ́ō, “to bring forth, to produce”).

8496.t: From συν- (sun-, “with”) + τυγχάνω (tunkhánō, “to happen (to), I succeed, I light upon, I obtain”).
